failures.rate_limited: The usage limit is reached. It clears at the time shown, and nothing retries by itself.

failures.overloaded: Claude is overloaded right now. Try again in a moment.
failures.version_out_of_range: This device's Claude Code is older than the minimum Hub needs. Update it, or use Open in VS Code.
failures.claude_missing: Claude Code was not found on this device.
failures.session_missing: Claude no longer has this conversation. Send again to start over from here.
failures.folder_not_allowed: That folder is not registered on this project.
failures.folder_missing: That folder does not exist on the device.
failures.device_offline: The device went offline during this turn, so the turn stopped. Any approval it was waiting on did not run. Send again once the device is back.
failures.cut_off: Claude Code stopped before the turn ended.
failures.unknown: This turn failed, and Claude did not say why.
failures.unreadable_event: Claude Code sent something Hub cannot read, so this turn was stopped. Open in VS Code to carry on there.

move.check_not_verified: It stays where it is: not every check matches a real step that succeeded.
move.check_dropped: It stays where it is: this report leaves out a check an earlier one named.
move.outside_panel: This chat is outside the panel, so the checks stay claimed and the task does not move.
move.not_a_task: It stays where it is: this card is not a task.
move.wrong_status: It stays where it is: only a started task moves to In review.
move.not_permitted: It stays where it is: your roles do not allow moving it.

startingWhy.model: The model changed, so it restarts on the same session
startingWhy.effort: The effort changed, so it restarts on the same session

status.retryNote: The server is busy. Nothing for you to do, and the turn is not lost.

approval.title: Your approval is needed

approval.command: The command, exactly as it will run

stopped.turn: Cancelled when the turn stopped. The command never ran

approval.once: Once only. A similar request pauses again.

vscode.title: Send to VS Code
vscode.lead: VS Code opens with the prompt written into Claude, and it is not sent. You press Enter there.
steps: The bridge opens the folder’s window on this device.
This text is written into Claude inside VS Code.
You press Enter when you want. Hub cannot send it for you.
vscode.newChat: That starts a new chat from a Hub summary and the card key. It is not this same chat.
vscode.noBridge: This device has no bridge, so it cannot open VS Code. Copy the text and paste it there.
vscode.sent: Sent to VS Code. Press Enter there.
vscode.noFolder: This project has no linked folder to open.

next.title: Do next
next.how: Ranked from card state, with no AI: overdue, then what blocks others, then priority.
next.empty: Nothing leads right now for this role.

empty.title: Ask from where you are
empty.body: Discuss, plan and execute here. Claude knows your project, your page and the open card.
empty.fills: A suggestion goes into the box. Nothing runs until you send.
empty.note: Anything that changes something waits until you send it. A read-only one runs on a press, and its row says so.

historyPanel.title: History
historyPanel.none: No chats in this project yet. One starts when you send your first message.

engine.alsoOffline: The device {device} is also offline right now.

offline.title: The bridge is offline on {device}
offline.body: Hub cannot start Claude there right now. Your chats are saved.
offline.action: It clears by itself when the device reconnects. Pick another device, or run this on that device:

signed_out.title: Claude is signed out on {device}
signed_out.body: Claude handles its own sign-in, and Hub never sees or stores your credentials. Sign-in only shows when a message is sent.
signed_out.action: Run this in a terminal on that device, then come back:

limit.title: Usage limit reached
limit.body: Paused until {time}. Chats stay as they are.
limit.action: It clears by itself at {time}, with nothing for you to do.

unknown.title: An error Hub does not recognise
unknown.body: The turn ended with no result. Try again, or continue the topic in VS Code.
unknown.action: Try again, or continue in VS Code.

revoked.title: {device} is no longer paired
revoked.body: Hub no longer accepts this device. The turn ended, and nothing pending ran.
revoked.action: Pair it again from Settings, Devices, or pick another device.

limit_open.title: Usage limit reached, with no known reset
limit_open.body: Claude did not say when the limit returns. You can send, and it may fail again.
limit_open.action: Send when you want to try.

version_new.title: Claude Code is newer than Hub has tested
version_new.body: Version {version} runs, and the tested one is {tested}. Permission rules stay active.
version_new.action: If something looks odd, continue in VS Code and tell Hub.

version_old.title: Claude Code is older than the minimum on {device}
version_old.body: Version {version} is installed, and the lowest Hub runs is {min}. The panel has stopped until you update it.

claude_missing.title: Claude Code was not found on {device}
claude_missing.body: The bridge is running, but it cannot find the program.

billing.title: A billing problem with Claude
billing.body: Claude refused the turn over billing. Hub cannot see your plan.
billing.action: Check your plan, then check again.

overloaded.title: Claude’s service is busy right now
overloaded.body: The turn failed after its retries. What finished before it stays.
overloaded.action: Try again in a little while.

session_missing.title: This chat’s session no longer exists
session_missing.body: Sessions stay on the device for 30 days. Hub’s copy of the chat stays, and the next turn starts a new session from it.
session_missing.action: Send your message and the new session starts.

folder_not_allowed.title: This folder is not on the project’s list
folder_not_allowed.body: The bridge works only in folders registered on the project.
folder_not_allowed.action: Pick a registered folder, or link it from the project page.

folder_missing.title: The folder does not exist on {device}
folder_missing.body: It may have moved or been deleted. Nothing started.
folder_missing.action: Pick another folder, or restore it and check again.

unreadable.title: Hub could not read an event, so the turn stopped
unreadable.body: Hub did not understand what Claude Code sent, so it stopped the turn rather than guess. What finished before it stays.
unreadable.action: Continue the topic in VS Code, or try again.

engine.checkedSignIn: Claude Code was found. Sign-in only shows with the next message, so send one to be sure.

no_device.title: No device is connected
no_device.body: Claude runs on a device of yours, through the bridge. None is paired with Hub yet.

no_folder.title: No folder is linked to this project
no_folder.body: The bridge works only in folders registered on the project.
no_folder.action: Link a folder from Settings, Devices.

pro.effortOff: {model} does not take effort. Pick Sonnet or Opus to change it.
pro.suggestions: Suggested requests from where you are

diff.large: A wider view of the diff for {path}
diff.loading: Reading the file on the device…
diff.unavailable: No diff is available: the device is away, or the file matches HEAD.

step.noOutput: No result arrived for this step.

turn.usageMissing: No usage was reported for this turn.
turn.retryNote: Sends the same request. Changes to files stay.
turn.branchNote: A new chat with a copy of the earlier words, up to here.
turn.branchedFrom: Branched from "{title}". Claude receives a copy of the earlier words, not the session itself.

plan.title: Proposed plan
plan.checks: Checks that will prove it worked
plan.asText: This plan arrived as text in the reply, so it has no separate steps.
plan.promptText: Carry out this plan, step by step, and run its checks.

report.title: Report on {key}
report.nothingListed: Claude listed nothing it did not check.

basis.outside_panel: From a chat outside the panel: no step can be verified there, so this is what Claude says.
basis.no_command: Claude named no command, so there is nothing to match.
basis.no_matching_step: No step in this chat ran this command, so this is what Claude says, not a result Hub verified.
basis.step_mismatch: The step it named ran something else.
basis.outcome_differs: Claude said it did not pass, but its last real run did.

summary.some: {verified} of {total} verified by Hub, {claimed} claimed by Claude

report.limit: Hub saw these commands run and succeed. It does not judge whether they are the right checks.
report.editsAfter: Edits came after this run, so it did not see them.
report.moved: Hub moved the card to In review: every check passed and was verified against a real step. The task does not complete itself: you confirm it. Not right? Send back on the card.

stays.check_not_passed: It stays: {names} did not pass. Submit for review stays yours on the card.
stays.check_not_verified: It stays: Hub could not verify {names}. Submit for review stays yours on the card.
stays.check_dropped: It stays: this report left out {names}, which an earlier one named. Submit for review stays yours on the card.
stays.no_checks: It stays: the report has no checks. Submit for review stays yours on the card.
stays.outside_panel: It does not move by itself: the report came from outside the panel, so no step can be verified.
stays.not_a_task: It is not a task, so it does not move by itself.
stays.wrong_status: It did not move: it is not In progress now.
stays.not_permitted: It did not move: this role is not allowed to.

report.refused: Hub refused a report: Claude said {names} passed, and its real step failed. Nothing reached the card.
report.filesClaimed: What Claude says: the device did not answer about files.

question.sendTip: Your answer reaches Claude, and it carries on.
question.incomplete: A question has no answer yet.

question.declineTip: Claude is told you did not answer, and carries on without it or stops.

question.declined: You did not answer, and Claude was told.

stopped.engine: Stopped: the turn ended in an error, and this was not answered.

draft.honest: Only what Claude flagged is flagged. A sentence with no mark is not proof it was checked.
draft.duplicates: Hub found a doc with a similar title

draft.conflictTitle: The document changed after this draft was written

draft.redraftNote: Update the existing document instead of writing a new one: {keys}.
draft.discardNote: Discarded by the owner. Do not save this draft.
draft.noSave: Save opens when Claude asks to save this draft.

saved.git: Nothing was committed to Git. That is a separate step, with your approval.

sheetNav.none: No other card this way in the list.

phoneTips.toChat: Goes back to the chat. The card stays open.
phoneTips.closeCard: Closes the card and keeps the chat.

default.note: What Claude Code chooses on this device

personas.owner: The whole project: decisions and handoffs first
personas.frontend: Interface tasks and ports from the lab
personas.designer: Lab versions and what awaits review
personas.pm: What is late and what blocks others

skills./hub:work: Do a task in fixed stages, with a report on the card
skills./hub:doc: Improve or write a doc, with a diff and flagged claims
skills./hub:plan: Plan something new, ending in a plan to run
skills./hub:ask: A question about the project docs, with sources

stripWords.label: Claude strip
stripWords.pageHidden: The page comes back when you close the card or the panel

labels.helpOn: Tap anything to see what it does.
labels.helpHint: Tap Explain, then anything, to see what it does. Or long press a button. Menus explain themselves.

strip:toggle.what: Opens and closes the panel from any page, even while you type.
strip:toggle.detail: The strip stays after closing, so an approval never goes out of sight.

strip:chat.what: Shows the open chat: the last reply and anything in it waiting for you.
strip:chat.then: If it is already showing, the panel closes.

strip:history.what: All your chats by project, pinned ones first.
strip:history.then: If it is already showing, the panel closes.

strip:runs.what: What waits for you, what is running now, and what to do next.
strip:runs.then: If it is already showing, the panel closes.

strip:pending.what: Approvals and questions waiting for you in any chat. Claude will not finish that step until you answer.
strip:pending.then: Opens the oldest chat that is waiting, scrolls to the approval and puts focus on it.

strip:bridge.what: The bridge runs Claude on your device.
strip:bridge.needs: The device being on and paired with Hub.

strip:usage.what: How much of your plan’s limit is used, as Claude reports it.
strip:usage.detail: At the limit the queue pauses until it resets, then continues, oldest first.

resize.what: Changes the panel’s width, and this device remembers it.
resize.detail: Arrow keys move in steps, Home and End go to the limits, Enter resets.

head:title.what: This chat’s facts. Press to see all of them under the title.

head:new.what: Starts an empty chat in your default mode.
head:new.then: The current chat stays in History, and a turn running in it carries on.

head:menu.what: Pin, export, open in VS Code, follow the chat, and panel settings.

head:close.what: Shrinks the panel into the strip. The chat and any running turn are not affected.

head:help.what: Makes each tap explain a control instead of pressing it.
head:help.then: Tap Done and taps work as usual again.
head:help.detail: A long press explains any button without this mode.

ctx:auto.what: What "this" means in your message. Press to send the next message without it.
ctx:auto.detail: Claude receives only the key and reads the rest through Hub, so the card is not copied into the chat.

ctx:leave.what: Sends the next message without this context.
ctx:leave.then: The context comes back after sending.

ctx:back.what: Puts the open card or doc back into the next message.

ctx:attached.what: Goes with the next message only, then the tray is clear.

ctx:detach.what: Takes it out of the next message.

ctx:followOffer.what: Claude read card {key}. Opening it here would move the page aside, so it did not open by itself.

attach:aside.what: Adds a card, a doc or a file to the next message, or inserts a saved template.
attach:aside.detail: Files come from the chosen folder only.

ctx:followOn.what: Claude opened this card because Follow the chat is on. It never takes focus from you.
ctx:followOn.then: Press to turn following off. This device remembers your choice.

ctx:followOff.what: Off: cards do not open by themselves.
ctx:followOff.then: Press to follow the chat. This device remembers your choice.

attach.what: Adds a card, a doc or a file to the next message, or inserts a saved template.
attach.detail: Files come from the chosen folder only. You can also drag any card from the page to here.

templates.what: Frequent prompts saved for this project.
templates.then: The text goes into the message and is not sent until you press Send.

input.what: Write to Claude, or start with / for the skills menu.
input.then: Claude reads the chosen folder’s CLAUDE.md and skills.

send.what: Sends the message with the chosen mode and model, and the context shown above it.
send.then: The first reply after Claude starts or restarts takes about 10 seconds, then it gets faster.

stop.then: What finished stays, and nothing else starts. You can retry afterwards.

mode:ask.what: Ask: reads files and Hub only, and answers.
mode:ask.detail: No terminal, and no tools from other servers, so it cannot run tests or change anything.
mode:ask.then: If it needs something refused, it says what and offers to switch. Changing mode restarts Claude, about 10 seconds on your next message.

mode:plan.what: Plan: reads files and Hub only, writes a plan, and changes nothing.
mode:plan.detail: No terminal, and no tools from other servers.
mode:plan.then: The turn ends in a plan with steps, checks and a button to run it. Changing mode restarts Claude, about 10 seconds.

mode:execute.what: Execute: reads and edits freely inside the folder, and runs commands.
mode:execute.then: It pauses for you on delete, commit, push, deploy, a new branch and docker. Changing mode restarts Claude, about 10 seconds.
mode:execute.detail: Your Claude Code rules stay loaded, so a command you always allow does not pause.

model.what: The model and effort for your next message.
model.then: A change restarts Claude on the same session, about 10 seconds before the next reply.
model.needs: What the installed Claude Code supports.

where.what: The device, the folder and the role Claude works in.
where.then: Changing device or folder starts a new chat, because each device keeps its own sessions.

suggestion.what: A suggestion from where you are now.
suggestion.then: Puts the text in the box. Nothing runs until you send it.

next:title.what: The cards worth picking up next in this project.
next:title.detail: The order is the line beside this title. Nothing here asks Claude.

next:explain.what: Explains the decision and what each option means. It does not decide for you.

next:open.what: Opens the card beside the chat.

tools:fold.what: The steps Claude took in this turn.
tools:fold.then: Opens the list, and each step opens to its exact input and result.

tools:step.what: Opens what went into this step and what came out, exactly, and who allowed it.

tools:copy.what: Copies the text exactly as it is.

turn:line.then: Opens its mode, model, usage and changed files, only as the engine reported them.

turn:menu.what: Retry, branch from here, and copy the reply.

turn:retry.then: What the last attempt changed in the files stays as it is.

turn:file.what: Shows what changed in this file.
turn:file.then: Opens the diff here, with added and removed lines marked by sign and colour.

turn:fileLarge.what: Opens the diff in a wider window.

user:menu.what: Branch from this message, or copy it.

facts:copy.what: Copies the session id, to find it again from Claude Code.

approval:copy.what: Copies the command exactly as it would run, to inspect or run it yourself.

stage.what: A stage of the work steps. Understand reads, Plan writes the steps, Execute edits, Verify runs the checks, Report writes to the card.
stage.detail: A failed check stops at Verify, which is what fails a stage.

plan:run.what: Puts this plan in the box, in Execute. Nothing runs until you send it.
plan:run.then: After you send, Claude restarts, about 10 seconds, then the checklist starts.

plan:aside.what: Leaves the plan in the chat without running it. You can come back to it.

report:open.what: Opens the card this report landed on, with its actions.

draft:save.what: Approves saving to the file on the main machine.
draft:save.then: The earlier text stays as a revision you can restore. No Git commit.
draft:save.needs: The file not having changed since the draft started. If it has, the save is refused and nothing is written.

draft:discard.what: Leaves the doc as it is. Nothing is saved.

flag:confirm.what: You confirm this claim is true.
flag:confirm.then: It is written plainly on save.

flag:leave.what: Takes the claim out of the draft.
flag:leave.then: It is not written into the doc.

flag:keep.what: Keeps the claim, marked as not verified.
flag:keep.then: It is written on its own line with that mark, so anyone reading the doc sees it.

draft:update.what: Drops this draft and writes on the existing doc, with no new file.
draft:update.then: A new draft as a diff against its text. Nothing is saved until you approve.

saved:restore.what: Brings back the earlier revision’s text.
saved:restore.then: The current text stays as a revision too, so you can undo the restore.

saved:open.what: Opens the doc on the Docs page behind the panel.

blocked:switch.what: Switches to Execute and sends the request again.
blocked:switch.then: Claude restarts, about 10 seconds, then works inside the folder and pauses on sensitive commands.

runs:answer.what: Opens the chat at the approval this run paused on.
runs:answer.then: The folder stays held until you answer.

runs:open.what: Opens this run’s chat so you can see what happened.

runs:state.what: Waiting, running, in line, scheduled, finished or cut off. The reason is under the title.

runs:card.what: Opens the card this run is working on.

history:row.then: A turn running in the current chat carries on.

history:more.what: Pin or delete. A delete can be undone.

history:pinned.what: Pinned to the top of its project.

sheet:explain.what: Explains this card and what is around it, and changes nothing.
sheet:explain.then: Starts a new chat in Ask.

sheet:plan.what: Writes a plan for this card, and changes nothing.
sheet:plan.then: The turn ends in a plan with a button to run it.

sheet:redesign.what: Starts a brief in the lab, then directions for you to choose from.
sheet:redesign.then: Nothing real changes until you approve a version.

sheet:do.what: Does the task in fixed steps: Understand, Plan, Execute, Verify, Report.
sheet:do.then: Runs as soon as you press, in Execute. The card moves to In progress, then to In review only if every check is verified against a real step.

sheet:vscode.what: Opens VS Code with the request written into Claude.
sheet:vscode.then: It is not sent: you press Enter there. That starts a new chat, not this one.
sheet:vscode.needs: A bridge on this device. Without one, it only copies the text.

evidence:chat.what: Opens the chat that wrote this report.

evidence:check.what: Shows this check’s output as it came, and each time it ran.
evidence:check.detail: Hub saw the command run and succeed. It does not judge whether it is the right check.

doc:improve.what: Proposes an update to this doc from the code and the cards.
doc:improve.then: Search, then a proposal, then a draft as a diff. Nothing is written until you approve.

doc:document.what: Writes what the open card achieved into the docs.
doc:document.then: It searches first, and warns you about a similar doc rather than repeating it.
doc:document.needs: A task card open beside the page.

doc:gaps.what: Compares what cards and code mention with what the docs say.
doc:gaps.then: You get a list of what is missing and out of date, with what was not checked. It writes nothing.

doc:revisions.what: The saved versions of this doc. Any of them can be restored.

doc:restore.then: The current text stays as a revision, so you can undo.

queue:run.what: Adds this to the agent queue to start now, in Execute, in the folder chosen in the panel.
queue:run.then: It starts when the limits allow, and pauses for you on commit, push, delete, deploy, a new branch and docker.
queue:run.needs: A paired device and a linked folder.

queue:schedule.what: Picks a time to run it, once or every week.
queue:schedule.then: If the main machine is off then, it starts when the machine is back, oldest first.

strip:run.what: A run from the agent queue. The icon says what it is doing now.
strip:run.then: Opens its chat, at the approval if it is waiting on you.

offline.why: The bridge is offline on {device}, so Hub cannot start Claude there.
offline.fix: Run hub doctor on that device, or pick another device. It clears by itself when it reconnects.

signed_out.fix: Run claude /login in a terminal on that device, then come back.

limit.why: You reached the usage limit. It resets at {time}.

unknown.why: The last turn ended in an error Hub does not recognise.
unknown.fix: Press Try again in the notice above the message box.

revoked.why: {device} is no longer paired with Hub.
revoked.fix: Pair it again from Settings, Devices.

taskInReview.why: This task is In review, and running it would redo finished work.
taskInReview.fix: Send it back from the card’s buttons if it needs work, or write to Claude yourself.

version_old.why: Claude Code on {device} is older than the minimum, so Hub will not run it.
version_old.fix: Update it with the command in the notice, then press Check again.

claude_missing.why: The bridge cannot find Claude Code on {device}.
claude_missing.fix: Install it, then press Check again.

billing.fix: Check your plan, then press Check again.

folder_not_allowed.why: This folder is not on the project’s list, so the bridge will not work in it.
folder_not_allowed.fix: Pick a registered folder, or link it from the project page.

folder_missing.why: The folder does not exist on {device}.
folder_missing.fix: Pick another folder, or restore it and check again.

empty.why: There is no text to send.
empty.fix: Write a message, or pick a template from the + button.

flagsOpen.why: A claim that could not be verified is waiting for your answer, and save_doc refuses until then.
flagsOpen.fix: Confirm the claim or take it out, above.

turnBusy.why: This turn is still running, and a chat runs one turn at a time.
turnBusy.fix: Wait for it to end, or press Stop.

noBridgeVs.why: This device has no bridge, so it cannot open VS Code.
noBridgeVs.fix: Open it from a device with a bridge, or copy the text from the dialog.

notTask.why: The open card is not a task, or no card is open.
notTask.fix: Open a task from the Tasks page beside this page.

taskClosed.why: This task is done or cancelled.
taskClosed.fix: Reopen it from the card’s buttons first.

noRevisions.why: This doc has no saved revisions yet.
noRevisions.fix: The first save through the panel starts them.

no_device.why: No device is connected to Hub.

no_folder.why: No folder is linked to this project.

noSave.why: Claude has not asked to save this draft.
noSave.fix: Ask it to save, in the chat.
